title: Report of the Special Committee on Investigation of the Munitions Industry (The Nye Committee)
publisher_or_archive: United States Government Printing Office, 74th Congress, Senate Report No. 944
summary: Landmark US Senate investigation examining how private munitions manufacturers and international financiers ('merchants of death') lobbied for foreign arms sales, bribed foreign officials, and systematically influenced US intervention into World War I to protect immense corporate profits, leading directly to the passage of the Neutrality Acts of the 1930s.
